notes.title: Anniversary Update Preview 3
notes.content:
In the upcoming version, we will be making a series of adjustments to the game to optimise gameplay.

[b]1. Character Attribute Adjustment[/b]
In the current version, each character has 20 points of extra attributes (evenly distributed to two attributes). In the upcoming adjustments, we will adjust each character's extra attributes in batches. The total increase in extra attributes will remain the same, but part of it will be increased and part of it will be weakened. The adjustments will make the differences between characters more apparent.

[b]2. Remove attribute boosts from levelling up[/b]
Characters will no longer be able to gain attribute boosts from levelling up.

[b]3.Secondary Position Attribute Adjustment[/b]
Attributes of Secondary Positions will be balanced to increase the playability of the less popular Positions and weaken some of the overpowered Secondary Positions.

[b]4. Skill Adjustment[/b]
Some of the skills will be adjusted, or their types and available professions will be changed to ensure that they are as effective as they are supposed to be.

[b]5. Adjustments to Scooping and Stealing effects.[/b]
Waiting to be revealed

*The above adjustments will be released in batches in future releases. The first batch of characters to receive adjustments include Eille, EilleWild, Wesley, WesleyWild, Dominic, DominicWild, and more. (Yevgenia and Victor will get adjustments in the version update)

[h2][b]Fix[/b][/h2]

[h2][b]New Card Type：Tactical Card[/b][/h2]
In this update, Tactical Cards have been added to FSFR.

Tactical Cards will provide players with unique support in terms of skill points, allowing them to gain a tactical advantage in matches.

Unlike normal cards, Tactical Cards have only one Card Effect and can only be placed on dedicated Tactical Card slots.

A Tactical Card's Card Effect is considered a Main Attribute and can be upgraded in the same way as a normal card. You can upgrade your Tactical like normal cards, but you cannot acquire Tactical Cards through Card Exchange. Tactical Cards cannot be applied to Card Refresh either, as they do not have a Sub Attribute.

Tactical Cards will not take up any of the original three card slots, and you will be able to equip up to two non-duplicated Tactical Cards.

Five Tactical Cards have been added to the game in this update

[b]Restore[/b]
Tactical Card-Restore provides players with periodic Skill Points restoration.

notes.title: Special Skill Series 2
notes.content:
[h2][b]Stone Tough（FW）[/b][/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42718614/09977dfdf42979c9239a43a7d0f051ebdc922239.gif[/img]
When using Stone Tough you will stop in place for a short period of time and improve your physical confrontation for a short period of time. Opponents who are in a physical confrontation with you will lose their balance.

This skill makes you an insurmountable obstacle in the path of an opponent, and although you can't use it when you're carrying the ball, you can use it to block a returning opponent for the player carrying the ball or to prevent a defender from interfering with a teammate's path to the goal. Naturally, this powerful skill is not "free", and it costs a hefty 4 Skill Points! This means you can only use this Special Skill a maximum of 3 times in an entire match, so take advantage of the opportunity!

[b]Crab Move（FW/MF）[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42718614/8857b1026c5c42bbac0607ec2ed61811bd543bad.gif[/img]
Activate Crab move while carrying the ball to quickly move sideways for a short distance.

When using Crab Move, you will move the ball a short distance laterally, perfect for getting around defenders or breaking up blocks. This skill only costs an affordable 2 Skill Points, which means you can use it frequently to create chances for yourself, whether it's a shot or a pass. 

[b]Harrier Flip（DF）[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42718614/bfe9cb1af0abf643b380c78ff8630d5dd8f40d28.gif[/img]
Use a backflip to intercept an opponent's pass or shot.

When you perform a Harrier Flip, you'll intercept a pass or shot with a backflip, especially those that come from high in the air or a hard shot. While you won't be able to keep the ball at your feet, even at a hefty 4 Skill Points, Harrier Flip has one of the best overhead interceptions in the game and doesn't get off-balance, which means that those who want to use other skills or specialties to compete with you for overhead kicks will need to think twice about spending their precious Now, spread your wings and make everyone's jaw drop!

notes.content:
[h2][b]Skill Points[/b][/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42718614/bd554a2831ad78285b57625c11080fe9c7c37814.png[/img]
At the start of the match all players will have 10 Skill Points, at the start of the second half you will replenish 5 Skill Points, but you will not be able to hold more than 10 Skill Points.

[h2][b]Slide Shot（FW）[/b][/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42718614/8d8383a24dae67cfb3d7d5b795531a5cebe82e51.gif[/img]
You will need to work with your teammates to use this skill when a pass is about to come close to you or is about to hit the ground, and of course you can also use Slide Shot on a ball that has been parried by the goalkeeper.
Slide Shot will make it harder for your opponent to predict the path of the ball and naturally harder to react to it. This skill costs 4 Skill Points, so be sure to communicate well with your teammates and take advantage of your opportunities.

[b]Scalpel（MF）[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42718614/6283f80f01ab83f697b7b5742821673707be67e7.gif[/img]
When you activate Scalpel, you'll make a long, fast aerial pass, which can be used to send the ball quickly from the wing or the backfield, which you'll find useful when launching counterattacks or crosses, and it only costs an affordable 2 Skill Points!

[b]Friendly Touch（DF）[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42718614/6513560daff96bfacd591559d5d6b4b5c3b7a5d1.gif[/img]
In a gentlemen's duel on the green, it is obviously unseemly to pull an opposing player. But in Freestyle Football, which allows the use of jujutsu, magic and cyber technology, it's perfectly permissible to involve both hands in the game! When you use Friendly Touch, you can throw the opposing player off balance from behind. This skill consumes the standard 3 Skill Points, which allows you to still have a chance to remedy the situation after being broken. However, if you touch something other than your opponent's back , you will lose your balance and thus lose your chance to defend completely. This means that you need to consider the timing of your skills.Now, reach out and surprise your opponent!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42718614/a590d49396f9d660a86f87c97b187c168fc91fc5.png[/img]
In the upcoming version, a brand new game mode is coming to Freestyle Football R! [b]The 1on
1 mode![/b]

In 1on1 mode you will operate four characters who will fight it out on the pitch to win. You can switch between the action figures to achieve complex court tactics.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42718614/5ff5a410bc0b7b9c9dcfa527722b4932f23511d0.gif[/img]

The 1on1 mode adds new operations into the game and you can adjust them in Setting.

Semi-assisted mode: Automatically switch to the target Character when passing the ball
Unassisted mode: switch Characters completely by hand

In 1on1 mode, your team members will come from among the Characters you own (if you have less than four characters, you can fill your team with up to three supernumerares). They will inherit their respective attributes, cards, but you will need to configure skills for them before the match starts. Your team will have a maximum of XX skill slots and all equipped skills will be shared by the whole team (only characters with the corresponding Positions can activate the corresponding skills)
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42718614/94b9db6bc309c66b17dee230080d668b1240231f.png[/img]

In addition to skills, you can choose up to 3 Team Buffs to enhance your team. Team Special Abilities consist of one Resident Team Buff and two Lucky Team Buffs. Find the best combination of buffs for your team!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42718614/fcba70deb85073d04736a28b294403cdbff39ff3.png[/img]

More than 10 Team Buffs will be added to the game in the upcoming version, and more will be added in the future! Stay tuned!

[b]Game Guide[/b]

We have uploaded the game guide in the steam community, the game guide contains the introduction and more detailed information about the game posted in Weekly, you can reach it through this link https://steamcommunity.com/app/1826980/guides/ The guide will be updated continuously in the future.


[b]Language support update planned[/b]

In an earlier contact we mentioned that we have plans to add more language support to the game.

Adding a language to the game is not a simple project: on the development side the text is often scattered in hundreds of files in different formats, mixed with the code. So stuffing these files into translation software or handing them all over to translators is obviously not a reasonable solution (Raw files, please - Sean on his first day at work, receive a Google translated game text from teammates), especially since these files may contain a lot of outdated content (Don't delete anything you can't use - summary of Sean's first week of work, result in 12 error reports). The finished translated text also needs to be adapted to the UI, icons, and animations programmers work in a result-oriented way, so don't follow the result and common sense to deduce the logic - Sean's first week summary, turn half of the UI into garbled code). Therefore, a thorough planning and systematic organization is necessary before starting a new language support project.


We will divide our update plan into several stages
1. Game terms and mechanisms
In the first stage, we will provide language support for game terms and mechanisms, including cards, skills, specialties and so on. These contents are the most helpful to players, and have been compiled and released as game guides.
2. Events
In the future event release, we will add new language support
3. Add language support to the game
The content in the previous stage will be released outside the game. At this stage, we will provide in-game language support.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42718614/b76fa61c2f8c48811341888593afb64a21dfa255.png[/img]
4. UI
The UI text is the least difficult to translate, but given that the UI text is embedded in multiple files in different formats and is not very difficult for most players to learn, it is a low priority
5. Pop up window and tips

notes.title: Weekly3：Skills，Currency，Scout Library
notes.content:
[h2][b]SKILL:[/b][/h2]
By equipping Skills, your character can actively or passively activate special effects. There are more than 30 types of Skills available in the game.With the right mix of Skills, your character can gain a wealth of tactical options.

In addition to enhancing your character, you can personalize your character by equipping Freestyle Skills and Ceremony Skills.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42718614/af0274d327fd7952801cb43a7dcc361a4cebb6a5.png[/img]

[h2][b]Currency[/b][/h2]
FSFR's main currencies include: Points, Coins, E-Coins and Scout EXPs.
[h3][b]Points:[/b][/h3]
Points are the most widely used currency in FSFR .You can earn points by playing games and game events.
[h3][b]Coins:[/b][/h3]
Coins can be used to purchase various premium items. 
[h3][b]E-Coins:[/b][/h3]
E-Coins can be used to purchase items in place of Coins (some items cannot be purchased with E-Coins). E-Coins can be obtained by participating in in-game events.
[h3][b]Scout EXPs:[/b][/h3]
See Scout Library for details

[h1][b]Scout Library[/b][/h1]
In Scout library, you can use Scout EXPs and points to recruit new special characters and buy character fragments.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42718614/f9ec19d8c2a7c7feb02fa60d40733c3edeed500e.png[/img]
For every match you win (competitive mode only), you will receive 1-3 Scout EXPs.
You can consume Scout EXPs to unlock Scout Library progress and consume Points to recruit specific Special Characters.
After the recruitment, you can buy Character Fragments with Scout EXPs
If you're not interested in any of the above or have already unlocked all the content, you can buy Butterfly Ninja's Capsule with Scout EXPs, which might contains some unexpected surprise.
More Special Characters will be added to Scout Library in the future.

We have placed advertisements through Google, and we will continue to adjust according to the results.  We have a steamer plan based on Twitch but it will take some time to realize.

2.	Will you provide Portuguese/Spanish language support for the game?

We have provided English support for the game and we will continue to update it until it is correct and nice（it's far from perfect now）. Support for other languages is in the long-term plan, but this will take a long time.

Europe, North America, South America
